name: mirante
description: A live session dashboard for Claude Code: context, cost and limits, repository and worktree, MCP server health, the slowest tools, subagents, permission checks and a session log.

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Comma-separated panels in display order: main, repo, mcp, slowest, agents, gate, turn, log. Leave one out to hide it.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: pane: the dashboard opens as a pane (docked beside the transcript in fullscreen, above the prompt otherwise). band: a summary of up to eight rows above the prompt in every layout, fullscreen included; /mirante still opens the full pane.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: The color of panel titles, gauges and highlights

git.title: Read git state
git.description: Run read-only git commands to fill the repo panel. Off: the repo panel is hidden and no git command runs.

slowest.title: Slowest calls listed
slowest.description: How many of the slowest tool calls the slowest panel lists (1-10)

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts (the terminal seats it only from 144 columns; /mirante opens it at any width)

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Context, cost and MCP trouble in the status line
